vignette: A 72-year-old hypertensive woman wakes with weakness of the left face, arm and leg that are all equally affected. Sensation, visual fields, speech and awareness are normal. CT is normal.
stem: The most likely site of the lesion is:

options.text: Right posterior limb of the internal capsule

explanation: A pure motor hemiparesis involving face, arm and leg equally without any cortical or sensory sign is a lacunar infarct in the posterior limb of the internal capsule (or basis pontis), where the corticospinal and corticobulbar fibers are packed together and the sensory fibers lie just behind.
